    • High probability of violation before Apr 6 given public contradiction and past pattern.

    • Monitor for a formal written agreement, Pakistan-mediated communiqué, and any strikes within 48 hours.

Situation Report — Day 27 (last 6 hours)

  • Pause / talks: Trump announced a SECOND pause on Iran energy strikes (10 days; deadline Apr 6, 2026 8PM ET), saying it followed an "Iranian government request" and that talks are "going very well." Iran denies direct talks. First pause (5 days) was violated within hours by US/Israeli strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr. Pakistan is mediating.
  • Diplomacy: US envoys heading to Doha. Iran pushing a Strait of Hormuz toll plan. France banned an Iran-opposition rally amid security concerns.
  • Air & airspace: Regional civil airspace largely shut: airports closed in Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan. Flight-scans show sharply reduced traffic and intermittent military flights recorded (IAF274, RCH535, C130).
  • Northern border (Lebanon): Netanyahu visited south Lebanon and said IDF will not withdraw "as long as Hezbollah remains here." Daily Hezbollah activity continues. Israeli strikes in Lebanon reported; front remains active.
  • Energy / Hormuz: Iran allows passage for selected friendly nations (Russia, India, China) while restricting others. Iranian officials claim resumed exports (>40M barrels) and report ~20% rise in domestic oil prices. Global oil market remains sensitive to strikes and shipping rules.
  • Security / arrests: 20-year-old US citizen arrested in Jerusalem on charges of spying for Iran. Israel shut a West Bank nonprofit over alleged terror links. IDF scrambled jets after a hijack false alarm; flight landed safely in Bulgaria.
  • 🟢 Good News: Flight landed safely after false hijack alert. Israel dispatched a humanitarian mission to Venezuela.

Threat assessment: Escalating
